Parts.Description: Warm sandstone paving with a golden sun mosaic under the Cheems God and marble tiles along the winding path.
Parts.Name: Sun Temple Floor

Parts.Description: A tall gate of marble pillars with golden capitals and dog ears across the entrance.
Parts.Name: Pillar Gate

Parts.Description: Four stone lanterns of different heights with golden roofs standing beside the entrance.
Parts.Name: Stone Lanterns

Parts.Description: A striped market stall selling golden dog treats, with crates of bones beside it.
Parts.Name: Treat Stall

Parts.Description: Glittering heaps of golden coins of all sizes with a treasure chest and a giant standing coin.
Parts.Name: Coin Hoards

Parts.Description: A round marble fountain with a golden bone on top, spraying coins into a clear basin.
Parts.Name: Coin Fountain

Parts.Description: The great marble hall of the altar: a stepped base, a colonnade, a golden gabled roof and a dome on top.
Parts.Name: Temple Hall

Parts.Description: Tall stone pillars of different heights crowned with golden fire bowls.
Parts.Name: Torch Pillars

Parts.Description: The shrine wall behind the Cheems God, with a golden sun niche and gilded pillars. The Shiba earns more.
Parts.Name: Altar Wall

Parts.Description: A calm pond of golden koi with lily pads, a stone rim and a little arched bridge.
Parts.Name: Koi Pond

Parts.Description: A three-storey pagoda with red curved roofs and a golden spire.
Parts.Name: Doge Pagoda

Parts.Description: Two marble dog statues of different sizes sit guard on stone bases, with golden collars and ears.
Parts.Name: Guardian Statues

Parts.Description: Three tall cloth banners of different heights on gold-capped poles.
Parts.Name: Wow Banners

Parts.Description: A huge arch made of two giant bones with a golden skull charm on top.
Parts.Name: Bone Arch

Parts.Description: Three tall golden pillars shaped like giant bones, each with knobbed ends, rising from a marble slab.
Parts.Name: Golden Bone Pillars

Parts.Description: Trimmed hedges, flower beds and three blossoming trees around a small stone path.
Parts.Name: Sacred Garden

Parts.Description: Three tall stone tablets carved with golden doge glyphs on a low slab.
Parts.Name: Meme Tablets

Parts.Description: A golden throne with dog ears on top, a red cushion and a lapis gem, standing on marble steps. The Shiba earns more.
Parts.Name: Doge Throne

Parts.Description: A marble altar table with a red and gold cloth, golden bowls, a treat cake and two candlesticks, with a bench on each side.
Parts.Name: Altar Table

Parts.Description: A cosy wooden kennel with a gold roof, a bone sign and a golden food bowl.
Parts.Name: Golden Kennel

Parts.Description: A red wooden frame with a golden roof from which three big bronze bells hang.
Parts.Name: Shrine Bells

Parts.Description: A giant golden sun disc with eight rays on a marble stand, facing the Shiba. The Shiba earns more.
Parts.Name: Sun Disc

Parts.Description: A giant golden crown with red and blue jewels resting on a marble pillar. The Shiba earns more.
Parts.Name: Crown Monument

Parts.Description: A seated golden Cheems statue with a red collar on a stone base.
Parts.Name: Cheems Statue

Parts.Description: White-gold marble steps in four broad tiers with gold bands, a front stair, two fire bowls and a golden altar block on top.
Parts.Name: Altar Steps

Parts.Description: A great golden halo ring held up by two marble pillars with golden caps.
Parts.Name: Halo Arch

Parts.Description: A stone vault with a golden door, marble pillars and stacks of coins in front.
Parts.Name: Treasure Vault

Parts.Description: A blossoming wish tree hung with red and golden ribbons.
Parts.Name: Wish Tree

Parts.Description: A towering column of warm golden light rising from a marble dais, ringed by three floating halo discs and a shining star.
Parts.Name: Holy Light

Parts.Description: The giant seated golden Doge guarding the altar, with a cream snoot, a red collar and tall ears. The Shiba earns much more.
Parts.Name: Giant Doge Statue
